title: Review of Explainable Decision Support and Adaptive Human-Machine Interfaces for Automation Transparency in Maritime Autonomous Surface Ships
abstract: arXiv:2509.15959v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Autonomous navigation in maritime domains is accelerating alongside advances in artificial intelligence, sensing, and connectivity. Opaque decision-making and poorly calibrated human-automation interaction remain key barriers to safe adoption. This article synthesizes 100 studies on automation transparency for Maritime Autonomous Surface Ships (MASS) spanning situation awareness (SA), human factors, interface design, and regulation. translated_title: 面向海上自主水面船舶自动化透明度的可解释决策支持与人机自适应接口综述
translated_abstract: 海事领域的自主导航正随着人工智能、传感和连接技术的进步而加速发展。决策过程不透明以及人机交互校准不良仍是安全采用的关键障碍。本文综合了100项关于海上自主水面船舶（MASS）自动化透明度的研究，涵盖态势感知（SA）、人为因素、接口设计和法规方面。我们（i）将指导-导航-控制栈映射到岸基操作模式，即远程监督（RSM）和远程控制（RCM），并识别了人在不安全控制行为（Human-UCAs）在交接和应急回路中的集中点；（ii）总结证据表明，透明度特征（如决策理由、备选方案、置信度/不确定性以及规则合规指标）能改善理解并支持信任校准，尽管可靠性和可预测性往往主导信任。
tldr: 本文综述了100项研究，指出透明度特征可提升信任校准，但可靠性和可预测性仍是关键，并识别了MASS操作中不安全控制行为的高发环节。
en_tdlr: This review of 100 studies finds that transparency features improve trust calibration, though reliability and predictability dominate, and identifies high-risk handover and emergency loops for unsafe control in MASS operations.
